canonical.title: A Weekend in Senigallia, Anchored on a Michelin Dinner

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Uliassi
sources.claim: Uliassi holds 3 Michelin stars in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Italia

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Madonnina del Pescatore
sources.claim: Madonnina del Pescatore holds 2 Michelin stars in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Italia

sources.title: Uliassi — official site
sources.claim: Uliassi is located at Via Banchina di Levante 6, Senigallia, on the sea between the harbour canal and the beach

sources.title: Uliassi menus 2026
sources.claim: Uliassi offers three tasting menus in 2026: Easy Classic (€260), The Classics 2026 (€280), The Lab 2026 (€280)

sources.title: Madonnina del Pescatore — official site
sources.claim: Madonnina del Pescatore is at Via Lungomare Italia 11, Marzocca (Senigallia)

sources.title: Senigallia conferma le 5 stelle Michelin 2026
sources.claim: Senigallia confirmed 5 Michelin stars total in 2026; Uliassi is the only 3-star in Marche and one of 15 in Italy

sources.title: Scatti di Gusto — Uliassi Lab 2026 Giacomelli menu
sources.claim: The Lab 2026 menu at Uliassi features colour-coded courses dedicated to Mario Giacomelli's centenary

sources.title: Feel Senigallia — Sea and Beach
sources.claim: Senigallia's seafront is 13 km of very fine golden sand, Blue Flag since 1997

sources.title: Feel Senigallia — Coastal Bike Paths
sources.claim: Dedicated bike paths run almost the full 13 km including an 8 km route to Marzocca

sources.title: Italia.it — Rotonda a Mare
sources.claim: The Rotonda a Mare is a 1930s rationalist seaside pavilion, hosting free exhibitions June-September

sources.title: Rocca Roveresca — official site
sources.claim: Rocca Roveresca opens daily 8:30-19:30; €5 full ticket

sources.title: Feel Senigallia — Foro Annonario
sources.claim: The Foro Annonario, a circular neoclassical market of 24 Doric columns, hosts a daily market and is a hub for aperitivo

sources.title: Feel Senigallia — Portici Ercolani
sources.claim: The Portici Ercolani run along the Misa river as 126 Istrian-stone arches

sources.title: Feel Senigallia — MUSINF
sources.claim: MUSINF holds a complete 250-photo anthology donated by Mario Giacomelli, including Scanno and Io non ho mani series

sources.title: Comune Senigallia — MUSINF at Palazzo del Duca
sources.claim: MUSINF is closed for renovation; collections moved to Palazzo del Duca, free admission

sources.title: Feel Senigallia — Brodetto alla senigalliese
sources.claim: Brodetto alla senigalliese: fish stew of 13 species in tomato, vinegar and Verdicchio

sources.title: Gelateria Paolo Brunelli
sources.claim: Gelateria Paolo Brunelli is among Italy's best, with Crema Brunelli and Portonovo flavours

sources.title: Rome2rio — Senigallia to Corinaldo
sources.claim: Corinaldo is about 20 minutes by car from Senigallia

sources.title: A perfect day in Le Marche: Mondavio and Corinaldo
sources.claim: Corinaldo pairs well with Mondavio for a single day trip; the Pozzo della Polenta is a must

sources.title: Ducal Palace, Urbino — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Urbino's Palazzo Ducale (UNESCO) houses the Galleria Nazionale delle Marche with Piero della Francesca's Flagellation

sources.title: Summer Jamboree 2026
sources.claim: Summer Jamboree 2026 runs 31 July to 9 August; ~400,000 visitors

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Uliassi
sources.claim: Uliassi rated 4.8/5 from 1,889 reviews; closed Mon-Tue; lunch 12:30-14:15, dinner 19:45-22:00

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Madonnina del Pescatore
sources.claim: Madonnina rated 4.8/5 from 1,399 reviews; closed Wed-Thu; tasting menu ~€230pp

sources.title: Reporter Gourmet — Madonnina Marco Polo menu
sources.claim: Madonnina's Marco Polo menu: dishes named after spice-route cities (Baghdad, Tehran, Aleppo, Samarkand, Beijing)

sources.title: Gastromondiale — Madonnina del Pescatore
sources.claim: Cedroni pioneered fish charcuterie; the Tunnel lab researches aging, fermentation, kombucha, spirulina

sources.title: Cibo Today — moscioli crisis
sources.claim: Slow Food suspended the moscioli Presidium for 2025 amid population collapse — don't plan around them

sources.title: SiViaggia — beach prices 2026
sources.claim: At a Senigallia stabilimento in 2026 an umbrella plus two loungers averages about €159/week, +0.6% over 2025

sources.title: Vivere Senigallia — Uliassi e Cedroni Michelin 2026
sources.claim: Uliassi: 'It's always incredible to be there among them'; Cedroni: 'The emotion of confirming them every year truly feels like winning them for the first time'

sources.title: Trainline — Senigallia to Jesi
sources.claim: Jesi is about 22 km from Senigallia, reachable by train in as little as 32 minutes

sources.title: Frasassi Caves — visitor info
sources.claim: Classic guided tour 75 minutes over 1,500 m at a constant 14°C

sources.title: Comune Senigallia — summer museum hours
sources.claim: Palazzo del Duca and Palazzetto Baviera open Thu-Sun with evening hours; Rocca Roveresca ticket earns a discount
